caption: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots. Bright green scallions crown the noodles in a white bowl with red kanji, set against a warm orange surface under soft, even lighting.

segments_info.text: Orange table surface, smooth and flat, with subtle wood grain texture visible beneath the bowl's shadow.
Chashu pork: tender, light brown slices with visible fat marbling and green onion garnish on top.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is rich, creamy, and golden-brown, swirling around noodles with green onions floating on top.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, sliced into thick, slightly curved pieces with glossy, moist surfaces.
White ceramic bowl with red characters and green floral pattern, smooth glossy surface, circular rim with decorative border.
